chosen_line.card: All Streams Flow to the Sea

answers.q1_what_did_you_play: I played Gorou — Inuzaka All-Round Defense and All Streams Flow to the Sea on Nibbit, then Coral Guard, dealing 15 damage and gaining 5 Block.
answers.q2_other_line_considered: I seriously considered playing Gorou — Inuzaka All-Round Defense, then Pearl Barrage while Exhausting Coral Guard, then All Streams Flow to the Sea, for 23 damage but no Block.
answers.q3_what_it_gave_up: It gave up 8 damage in exchange for 5 Block against the telegraphed 12-damage attack.
answers.q4_different_intent: Yes. If Nibbit had not telegraphed damage, I would have favored the 23-damage line that Exhausts Coral Guard with Pearl Barrage.
